allow: Shell(git status 2>&1 | head -5; echo "---"; java -version 2>&1; echo "---"; which gradle kotlin 2>&1; echo "---"; echo $ANDROID_HOME $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT; ls ~/Android/Sdk 2>/dev/null || ls /opt/android-sdk 2>/dev/null || echo "no sdk found in common paths")

Shell(uname -a; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "---"; which curl wget apt-get dnf unzip zip 2>&1; echo "---"; df -h /home /tmp 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---"; free -h 2>/dev/null | head -3; nproc)
Shell(sudo apt-get install -y -qq openjdk-17-jdk-headless unzip zip 2 >& 1)

Shell(for url in "https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/Adoptium/17/jdk/x64/linux/" "https://mirrors.aliyun.com/adoptium/" "https://aka.ms/download-jdk/microsoft-jdk-17-linux-x64.tar.gz" "https://download.java.net/java/GA/jdk17.0.2/dfd4a8d0985749f896bed50d7138ee7f/8/GPL/openjdk-17.0.2_linux-x64_bin.tar.gz"; do code=$(curl -sI --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}" -r 0-0 "$url" 2>/dev/null); echo "$code <- $url"; done)
Shell(cd ~/jdks && tar xzf jdk17.tar.gz && rm jdk17.tar.gz && JAVA_HOME=$(ls -d ~/jdks/jdk-17* | head -1) && echo "JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME" && $JAVA_HOME/bin/java -version 2>&1)
Shell(find ~/jdks/jdk-17.0.2 -name "libjli.so" 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls ~/jdks/jdk-17.0.2/lib/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; du -sh ~/jdks/jdk-17.0.2)
Shell(mkdir -p ~/jdks/fresh && tar xzf /dev/null 2>/dev/null; cd ~/jdks/fresh && find ~/jdks -maxdepth 1 -name "*.tar.gz" -exec ls -la {} \;)

Shell(for url in "https://mirrors.cloud.tencent.com/gradle/gradle-8.9-bin.zip" "https://mirrors.aliyun.com/macports/distfiles/gradle/gradle-8.9-bin.zip"; do code=$(curl -sI --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$url"); echo "$code <- $url"; done)
